chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 222: Ancestral God's Palace Opens
chapter_meta_description: The Decline God transports cultivators to the Heavenly Palace of Ancestral God Youchao. Legendary beasts and figures gather as the palace gates finally open. Xiao Chen witnesses a grand assembly of myths.
og_title: World of Immortality #222: The Heavenly Palace Emerges
og_description: The Heavenly Palace of the Ancestral God appears in the sky, drawing legendary cultivators and mythical beasts. Xiao Chen is caught in the midst of this epic gathering.
twitter_title: Immortality Ch.222: Ancestral God's Heavenly Palace Revealed
twitter_description: Ancient beasts, Fallen Angels, Kongxuan, and the Four Immortal-Slaying Swords converge as the Heavenly Palace opens. A monumental chapter in World of Immortality.
